## Personality

The Twin Sailor is known to be a jolly tar. Having seen everything in the world, they maintain a cheerful demeanor.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)_

## History

During her time teaching her pupils, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) received an imaginative composition written by the Twin Sailor. This piece was among the various student letters and classroom incidents she later detailed in a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
